pages.h1: ByteTrack — the boring trick that ate multi-object tracking
pages.lead: Most tracking pipelines throw away low-confidence detections. ByteTrack keeps them — and uses them in a second matching pass. That’s essentially the whole idea. This page is about why such a small change beat everything else in 2022.

ByteTrack didn’t arrive in a vacuum. SORT, DeepSORT, FairMOT, OC-SORT, BoT-SORT, StrongSORT — each one is a different answer to “how do you keep an ID stable when the detector flickers?” This page is a map of that landscape and an honest take on where ByteTrack wins, where it loses, and what to reach for instead.
